info.title: Yampi Universal API
info.description: Yampi app built on the official REST API using direct API credentials (Alias, User Token, and User Secret Key).

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated user from Yampi.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

active.description: Whether the authenticated user is active.

merchantOwner.description: Whether the authenticated user owns a merchant account.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
